# Koi StyleKit

Koi StyleKit is an open-source illustration style catalogue and local prompt tool.
It contains 300+ reusable style recipes grouped into 48 style families.

## What it does

- Browse, search, filter, compare, favorite, and paginate illustration styles.
- Export Chinese prompt recipes and a JSON style package.
- Run locally with Python; the tool does not call an image-generation API.

## Canonical project files

- README.md: Chinese overview, setup, CLI usage, limitations, attribution.
- README.en.md: English overview and setup.
- SKILL.md: instructions for using the catalogue as an agent skill.
- wireframes/styles.json: structured catalogue data.
- scripts/koi.py: shared prompt renderer and CLI.

## Trust and limitations

Sample images are candidates and do not guarantee cross-topic or cross-model reproduction.
The project does not upload themes, provide online image generation, or include an MCP server.
